purpose: 全原79和29季度固定来源资格登记，先六原响应精确复用，不修改现有源码
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_full_original_source_v1"
parent=root/"reports/research/510300_2018q3_loan_allocation_release_pdf_binding_v1"
def now():return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def rel(p):return p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
def ref(p):return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes())}
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name,x):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError("原登记产物已存在，禁止重复："+rel(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def git(*args):return subprocess.run(["git",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",check=True).stdout
proposal_path=parent/"next_experiment.json"
assert sha(proposal_path.read_bytes())=="071bae7260586f3bd0177238feaac49c26e84414fe99a68fa0d9a0167fef8e80"
proposal=read(proposal_path)
assert proposal["experiment_id"]=="E116" and proposal["status"]=="PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN"
p112=root/proposal["original79_parent"]["path"]
assert sha(p112.read_bytes())==proposal["original79_parent"]["sha256"]
demand=proposal["proposed_identity_demand_only"]
assert len(demand)==79 and len(proposal["fixed_distinct_target_loan_quarters"])==29
old114=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_prior_use_source_v1"
p114=old114/"三原贷款投向完整原量原范围自己公开钟及同钟多维背景_v1_0_1_E114.json"
assert sha(p114.read_bytes())=="669e83c874ccbb987afca6d2287ddf439061e62c40baabc51cf400f50a509dda"
reuses=[]
for row in read(p114)["rows"]:
    fp=root/row["raw_source_path"];assert sha(fp.read_bytes())==row["raw_source_sha256"]
    q=row["fixed_original_case"]["fixed_target_loan_stat_quarter"]
    reuses.append({"quarter":q,"origin":"E114完整原稿","url":row["source_url"],"raw_source":ref(fp),
      "saved_quantity_artifact":ref(p114),"saved_row_quarter":q,
      "own_publication_at":proposal["known_example_source_clocks"][q],
      "clock_origin":ref(parent/"原发布事件标题自己公开钟与精确附件绑定_E115.json") if q=="2018Q3" else ref(p114),
      "historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,"source_quantity_previously_qualified":True})
old=root/"reports/research/510300_historical_index_credit_realization_v1"
manifest_path=old/"source_manifest.json"; manifest=read(manifest_path)
for row in manifest:
    if not row["id"].startswith("purpose_"):continue
    fp=root/row["path"];assert sha(fp.read_bytes())==row["sha256"]
    soup=BeautifulSoup(fp.read_bytes(),"html.parser"); text=soup.get_text(" ",strip=True)
    native_clock_nodes=[str(n.parent) for n in soup.find_all(string=re.compile(re.escape(row["page_date"]))) if n.parent.name not in ("script","style")]
    native_clock_meta=[dict(m.attrs) for m in soup.find_all("meta") if m.get("name","").lower()=="pubdate"]
    national=all(k in re.sub(r"\s+","",text) for k in ["人民银行统计","金融机构人民币各项贷款余额","工业中长期贷款余额","住户贷款余额","房地产贷款余额"])
    assert national and native_clock_nodes,"既存投向原稿未满足复用身份/公开头："+row["id"]
    reuses.append({"quarter":row["period"],"origin":"旧指数信用兑现完整全国原报告官方转载，已非首次经济用途","url":row["url"],
      "raw_source":ref(fp),"prior_manifest":ref(manifest_path),"prior_source_id":row["id"],
      "native_publication_nodes":native_clock_nodes,"native_PubDate_meta":native_clock_meta,
      "own_publication_at":row["page_date"]+"T23:59:59+08:00",
      "clock_origin":"同原明确官方转载公开头取日末，PubDate更精确时仍保持既有保守上界",
      "historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,"source_quantity_previously_qualified":True})
assert len(reuses)==6 and len({x["quarter"] for x in reuses})==6
missing=[q for q in proposal["fixed_distinct_target_loan_quarters"] if q not in {x["quarter"] for x in reuses}]
queries=[{"quarter":q,"q":q[:4]+"年 "+{1:"一",2:"二",3:"三",4:"四"}[int(q[-1])]+"季度 金融机构贷款投向统计报告","domains":["pbc.gov.cn","gov.cn"]} for q in missing]
save("六既存原稿精确身份量范围公开上界复用核对_E116.json",{
 "at":now(),"rows":reuses,"reused_complete_original_quarters":6,"fixed_missing_original_quarters":missing,
 "prior_actual_allocation_cause_role_previously_observed":True,"new_requests_in_local_review":0,
 "note":"2022Q4/2023Q1保守政府转载时间晚于若干原截止可能不合格，全部原身份保留，不借其他事件补钟"})
save("运行前git记录_E116.json",{"at":now(),"branch":git("branch","--show-current").strip(),"HEAD":git("rev-parse","HEAD").strip(),
 "tracked_status":git("status","--short","--untracked-files=no")})
protocol={
 "experiment_id":"E116","study_id":"510300_ACTUAL_LOAN_ALLOCATION_FULL_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_V1","registered_at":now(),
 "status":"REGISTERED_ALL79_29QUARTERS_BEFORE23_FIXED_QUERIES",
 "question":proposal["question"],"role":"完整原79来源资格和多维共同经营解释，不是金融候选登记。",
 "parent_proposal":ref(proposal_path),"parent_result":ref(parent/"result.json"),"original79_parent":ref(p112),
 "reuse_review":ref(out/"六既存原稿精确身份量范围公开上界复用核对_E116.json"),
 "fixed_original_identities":demand,"fixed_distinct_target_loan_quarters":proposal["fixed_distinct_target_loan_quarters"],
 "reused_complete_original_quarters":[x["quarter"] for x in reuses],"fixed_queries":queries,
 "fixed_selection_rule":proposal["fixed_selection_rule"],
 "raw_selection_rule":proposal["new_source_budget_after_registration_and_unique_reuse_review"]["selection_rule"],
 "national_title_identity_rule":"原年及原一/二/三/四季度全国金融机构贷款投向统计报告；Q4允许同原年末的全国年度投向报告，全年净增不当Q4单季。",
 "reuse_rule":"同原完整报告已有首次响应，保留自身时钟和未知，0重取/另载体，不因较晚转载改取更早日期。",
 "complete_source_rule":"保存完整全文/PDF全部页、HTML原表、原量币种/借款总体/余额净增/母体和全部附注；不是摘录、目录、地方自身统计或其他季度。",
 "clock_rule":"各原稿明确PubDate或自己原文章公开头；仅日期保守日末。PDF无已绑定原公开事件则UNKNOWN，不再取得父页。URL/创建/修改/成文/HTTP/取得/他稿均不补钟；每原身份按原截止独立判资格。",
 "quantity_rule":"沿E114原量语义模式及20字段角色，未报告或歧义显式UNKNOWN，不合成跨币种比例/重叠行业总额；保留新发放/滚续/现金/预期差未知。",
 "joint_cause_rule":"全部79同钟原价格、资金、订单、利润、应收回收、库存周转、有年龄基金及母体一起保留；同源同公布信息不作独立票，不读取后续股市标签。",
 "request_budget":{"fixed_queries":len(queries),"maximum_first_GETs":len(queries),"retries":0,"extra_queries":0,"redirect_following":0,"alternate_carriers":0,"authenticated_requests":0,
    "connect_timeout_seconds":12,"read_timeout_seconds":30,"TLS_verify":True,"concurrency_max":4},
 "financial_budget":proposal["financial_budget"],"admission_boundary":proposal["admission_boundary"],
 "original79_1711_1212_preserved":True,"all_original_mature_source_support":"NOT_COMPUTED_NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "prior_actual_allocation_cause_role_previously_observed":True,"new_financial_information_admitted":False,
 "old_monthly_maturity_and_all_prior_financial_failures_preserved":True,"old_saved_performance_reports_read_for_prior_use_before_E116":True,
 "current_fixed79_stock_labels_read":False,"DR007_no_valid_access_preserved":True,"closed_source_routes_not_retried":True,
 "historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,
 "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,"prospective_forecasts":False}
save("protocol.json",protocol)
save("二十三固定定位查询认领_E116.json",{"at":now(),"protocol":ref(out/"protocol.json"),"queries":queries,
 "all_claimed_before_requests":True,"queries_per_original_quarter":1,"retries":0,"extra_queries":0})
print(json.dumps({"E116":"实际事前登记","原身份":79,"固定原季度":29,"既存完整原稿复用":6,
 "缺稿固定查询":len(queries),"查询原期":missing,"金融候选":0,"拟合":0,"现有源码修改":0,"协议SHA256":sha((out/"protocol.json").read_bytes())},ensure_ascii=False))
